_about: Answer key for the test photos. Source: the sister's handwritten notes (21 Nov 2026), confirmed by her. One entry per photo.

parts: pudding body: brown top (R1-R3), light yellow sides (R4-R10), stuffed with cotton

cherry: Glue: cut the yarn short. Sew: leave a long tail to sew cherry + whipped cream + pudding together.
whipped_cream: R1: mr (2ch, hdc, 2ch, slst on the ring)*4
pudding: R3: (sc, inc)*6 [18]  (confirmed by the sister; the page said *2)
Slst on the 1st stitch, cut the yarn and weave in the end

entries.item: sunflower granny square cardigan (photo shows part of a garment)
entries.note: The sister wrote ONE granny square only. Joining, border and shaping are not written down.
pattern_one_square: Brown yarn: R1: mr, 2ch, 16dc in mr (slst at the end)
Orange yarn (petals): R2: 3ch, puff stitch all around in the 16dc (slst at the end)
Yellow yarn (petals): R3: 3ch, dc clusters all around in the 16dc (slst at the end)

Green yarn (squaring the circle): R4: 4ch (counts as a tr), corner start 2tr, sides 3dc / hdc sections, full corner (3tr, 3ch, 3tr), repeat until the square is complete, end with 3tr in the first stitch and 3ch (slst at the end)
entries.status: to confirm with the sister: the crossed-out 3dc in R4

pattern: White yarn (2ch at the start of every round, slst at the end of every round):
R2: ch 2, dc inc all across (12dc becomes 24dc)
R6: ch 1, sc (ch 3, skip 2 stitches, sc) until the end, slst
R7: unclear handwriting, to confirm with the sister
R8: ch10, 9 single crochet increase, ch 1, fasten off, sew flower (repeat until 2 flowers)
